description: Update an existing Jira issue. You can change the summary, description, and/or set arbitrary fields via additional_fields.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

additional_fields.description: Additional fields to set, as a JSON object of field ID to value (e.g. {"priority": {"name": "High"}})

description.description: New description (plain text, will be converted to ADF)

name: atlassian-mcp__jira_update_issue
